ranking.selection: Exact first 4000 rows in snapshot order; latest PyPI info.version at metadata fetch; one non-yanked sdist from that release; no historical fallback.

upstream_filter_reference.attribution: Filename, first256bytes binary, Cython firstline and pythoncapi_compat.h exclusion behavior follows Victor Stinner misc search_pypi_top.py. Upstream files linked, not redistributed.

survey.py.description: Original survey analysis preserved outside this portable publication; public reproduction adapts lexical rules and safe iteration.

canonical_method.py.description: Original survey analysis preserved outside this portable publication; public reproduction adapts lexical rules and safe iteration.

read-access-analysis/recover_sources.py.description: Original survey analysis preserved outside this portable publication; public reproduction adapts lexical rules and safe iteration.

metadata.selection: Exact frozen current release URL selected by original survey and verified against pinned upstream find_url for all4000names; no live metadata refresh. Latest meant latest at recorded fetch time.

parser_changes: Standalone scanner combines original write tokens and expanded recovery read tokens; original_write_scope flag preserves initial symbol subset.
Exact upstream filename endswith filter used, including .js.map (not all .map); original recovery independently used a broader .map suffix skip.
All candidate metadata/hits retained by default; original scripts retained source bytes, new portable default does not.
Optional source retention supports candidate files or all native/Unicode-bearing files; no third-party source corpus is bundled.
128MiB candidate text-member limit is explicit; original recovery limit never triggered in observed corpus. Every future skip is enumerated; no global expanded-size cutoff.
Lexical classifications are heuristics copied from original analysis; manual semantic A/B/C/U inventory requires separate source review and is not automatically reproduced.
